subject: T423: multi-model whole-Bible chunking fork (experimental)
summary: Logos-scripture-graph is trying a speed fork: 4-5 AI models each run a continuous whole-Bible chunking marathon in separate scratch folders (M1_cursor..M5_composer_alt), starting from the same research baseline (literature types, grammar, Strong's G/H, wj/red-letter, observation substrate). After marathons: agreement spans = easy/consensus chunks; disagreement delta = governed focus queue. If fork fails, revert to T410 parallel_chunking_research_program baseline.
